title: Global EV Components Market Size, Share, Trends, and Forecast, 2026-2036 | $1.28 Trillion Opportunity Driven by 800-Volt Systems, Solid-State Batteries, and Power Electronics
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global EV Components market is estimated at USD 486.4 billion in 2026 and projected to reach USD 1.28 trillion by 2036, expanding at a 10.2% CAGR. Growth is driven by rapid EV adoption, declining battery costs, 800-volt electrical architectures, and solid-state battery development. Battery systems remain the largest component category, while power electronics are expected to record the fastest growth. Asia-Pacific leads the market, with Europe expected to register the fastest regional growth.

title: Global Microprocessor Market Size, Share, Growth Trends, and Forecast 2026-2035 | AI, High-Performance Computing, Automotive, and IoT Drive 8.7% CAGR Toward USD 191 Billion
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global microprocessor market is projected to grow from USD 85.4 billion in 2025 to USD 191 billion by 2035, expanding at an 8.7% CAGR. Growth is driven by rising demand for AI, high-performance computing, automotive electronics, IoT, and industrial automation. ARM architecture processors and mobile/laptop segments are key growth areas, with North America accounting for 22.9% of the market. Leading companies are investing in AI-optimized designs, energy-efficient chips, and strategic partnerships to strengthen their positions.
